headline: Eurasian Development Bank to Invest $60M in Uzbekistan Rail Logistics
summary: The Eurasian Development Bank will allocate up to $60 million through Islamic financing for Centrum Global Logistics to purchase 2,683 rail tank cars, expanding petroleum transportation in Uzbekistan.
why: Infrastructure financing agreements enhance transport capacity and facilitate cross-border trade corridors.

impacts.name: Centrum Global Logistics
impacts.why: Debt financing enables fleet expansion and scales operational logistics capacity.
